snippet.title: DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO - DAIMA Character Pack 1 Trailer
snippet.description:
Get ready for the next adventure in DRAGON BALL Sparking! ZERO when DLC 2: DRAGON BALL DAIMA: Character Pack 1 drops on April 24th, 2025! 

Can't wait? Early access begins today! See you online, Warriors.
